transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. We need to get moving on the quarter-end property reconciliation for the items currently tagged unserviceable — battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables. Per policy, I need current technical status and disposition recommendations from each responsible section before I can sign the disposition order. I'll be recording everything in the maintenance control log once we settle on dispositions. Who can start us off with status updates on these items?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, sir. I can start with the battery packs. My shop inspected all six unserviceable battery packs this morning. They have swollen casings, which falls under a manufacturer safety bulletin. Because of that safety bulletin, our recommendation is quarantine — not repair. We've scheduled property-office pickup for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is currently still in our shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log. I'll make sure that gets documented properly.
